erin.lede: Six parts that turn together. We build them with n8n and in your platform, and we keep them running.

parts.label: CRM
parts.txt: WhatsApp, Instagram, email, SMS and phone calls in one inbox. Customer history, notes, tags and pipeline status update by themselves.

parts.label: Appointments
parts.txt: An instant confirmation by email and SMS, a reminder 1 day before and a final SMS 2 hours before with your address. After 6 weeks, an invitation for next time. Syncs with Google Calendar.

parts.label: Missed calls
parts.txt: Miss a call? The caller gets an SMS with your booking link straight away.

parts.label: Reviews
parts.txt: 2 hours after every appointment, a review request goes out by SMS or email. Happy customers go to Google. Anyone who isn't happy comes to you first.

parts.label: Payments
parts.txt: After every payment via Stripe, an invoice goes out. If an invoice is still unpaid, automatic reminders follow. With Bancontact, iDEAL, Visa and Apple Pay.

parts.label: Enquiries
parts.txt: A new enquiry lands with the right person and gets followed up automatically. Email and SMS campaigns start based on what your customer does.

erin.onrust: In a watch, the little ticking wheel is called the balance wheel. We keep it moving: we build your workflows and maintain them. So keeping things in balance is our job, not yours.

bewijs.lede: At Clinic3D, an aesthetic clinic in Hasselt, confirmations, reminders and follow-up go out fully automatically. 2,090 of those emails were opened. And the no-show counter stayed at zero.
bewijs.quote: My clients now book by themselves — I don't have to do a thing.
bewijs.note: Measured from 1 January to 20 September 2026 (263 days). Dr. Kenis said this after 104 days.
bewijs.caption: Each dot is one email. Which dots light up is random, but the numbers are real.
bewijs.dots_label: 3,250 automatically sent emails, of which 2,090 were opened (64%), with 214 clicks, 20 replies and 8 unsubscribes.

windows.label: no-shows
windows.sub: not a single one in 263 days

items.a: No. We build the workflows and maintain them. You only approve the moments and the wording.
Automation has no separate price. It's part of Digital Growth: €150 per month, cancellable monthly. If you'd also like an AI chatbot or an AI receptionist, that's an extra €50 or €125 per month.
Confirmations and reminders, review requests, invoices after a payment and reminders for unpaid invoices, passing on and following up enquiries, email and SMS campaigns, and updates in your CRM.
